scope: All six ordinary body-flow citation keys and all twelve frozen citation claims were checked for existence, canonical metadata, exact nearby support, hypotheses, source authority, relevance, bibliography coverage, non-library coverage, and final LaTeX/BibTeX consistency; no priority beyond the dated search record is certified.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check-skill search audit followed by a BibTeX consistency audit: citation claims were extracted and frozen first, then each claim was sequentially verified against primary article text or authoritative publisher/archive records, exact source locators, the active user-library registry, and the converged AUX/log join; no sub-agents were used because the user prohibited them.
